title: Proposal: private boards (large private forums) as broadcast channels
description: Design note notes/private-boards.md (2026-10-18). A board = broadcast channel (§5.2.1.4) whose broadcasterRoles includes the member role. Additions: (1) one sentence permitting many-poster broadcast + client indicator; (2) message delete defined for broadcast channels (§4.5 assumes MLS); (3) history beyond relay retention: long relay retention (preferred) or CO archive read API (§5.2.5); (4) optional CO thread/search index service. Security model must be stated: no FS within an epoch, removal forward-only, members can leak, CO reads plaintext. Open questions for Mark in note §7: scale target, sysop reads, history policy default, archive source, pseudonymity.
